summary: Retested iteration_9 quota fix. All 5 full-size drafts (1067x1600 canvas) now persist successfully — photoedit_drafts_v2 in localStorage is a valid JSON array of length 5, total size ~733 KB (vs. >8 MB in iteration_8). Draft data is stored as JPEG (prefix 'data:image/jpeg;base64,/9j/4AA') and w/h metadata reflect the original 1067x1600 canvas. Ordering is newest-first (Draft 5, 4, 3, 2, 1). Autosave banner, restore, rename, delete, and persistence across reload all continue to work. Auto-save useEffect now depends on stable saveAuto callback — no interval churn observed in console.
critical_code_review_comments: useDraft.saveNamed: still uses stale `drafts` closure via useCallback deps — fine but consider functional setState to avoid re-creating on each drafts change.
Editor.jsx saveDraft default prompt name still uses `draft.drafts.length + 1` which can collide with renamed drafts (minor UX).
canvasPayload always re-encodes JPEG — no cache; if user hits Save 5x in a row on unchanged canvas, cost is 5x re-encode. Not a bug, just perf.
seed_data_creation: None. localStorage cleared between runs. Tested with default sample image (1067x1600).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration_8 HIGH quota bug is FIXED. 5 full-size drafts now fit in ~733 KB via JPEG@0.72 max-1200px. All existing draft features (rename, delete, load, autosave banner/restore/discard, legacy migration, drafts-tab-count, drafts-empty) previously verified in iteration_8 still work. If regressing, check photoedit_drafts_v2 JSON length + first draft's data prefix (must be data:image/jpeg).
rca of the issue: Fix verified. saveNamed's iterative drop-oldest retry loop was not needed in practice — the JPEG compression alone brings 5 drafts to 733 KB, well under 5 MB. Fallback loop remains as safety net for extreme cases.
